skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and explain the economic nature of pollution, measure economic damages caused by pollution, and value natural resources and environment.
Apply economic tools and management techniques to address environmental issues.
Analyze and propose solutions for sustainable development issues.
Understand and apply concepts related to green growth and circular economy.
Study and understand the economic aspects of climate change.
Conduct cost-benefit analysis and economic valuation of natural resources and environment.
Manage renewable and non-renewable natural resources effectively.
Work collaboratively in groups to solve practical problems.
Develop independent learning skills to complete assignments and solve real-world problems.
Analyze and evaluate complex environmental issues critically.
Prepare and deliver effective presentations on environmental management topics.
